title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A2–B1）
section: 第 3,101–3,150 個單字（CEFR B1 中級）

words.definition: 個性；人格特質；魅力名流

examples.en: Her warm, cheerful personality makes everyone feel instantly welcome.
examples.zh: 她溫暖開朗的人格特質讓身邊每個人都能瞬間感受到賓至如歸。

examples.en: Psychologists use various tests to study different facets of human personality.
examples.zh: 心理學家使用各種測驗來研究人類人格特質的不同層面。

examples.en: He has a magnetic personality that attracts friends wherever he travels.
examples.zh: 他擁有一種極具吸引力的個人魅力，無論走到哪裡都能結交到朋友。

examples.en: Introverts recharge their energy through quiet reading and peaceful solitude.
examples.zh: 內向者通常透過安靜閱讀與獨處沉澱來為自己的心靈重新充電。

examples.en: As a natural introvert, he prefers one-on-one conversations over loud networking mixers.
examples.zh: 作為一個天生性格內向的人，他偏愛一對一的深入交談，而非喧鬧的社交派對。

examples.en: Introvert leaders often excel at deep listening and thoughtful decision-making.
examples.zh: 內向型領導者往往在深入聆聽與縝密決策方面表現出色。

examples.en: Extroverts gain vibrant energy from lively social gatherings and teamwork.
examples.zh: 外向者在熱鬧歡樂的社交聚會與團隊互動中能汲取充沛飽滿的活力。

examples.en: Being an outgoing extrovert, she thrives in public relations and sales roles.
examples.zh: 身為個性外向開朗的人，她在公關和業務銷售等職務上如魚得水。

examples.en: The office team is a balanced mix of thoughtful introverts and energetic extroverts.
examples.zh: 辦公室團隊由心思縝密的內向者與精力充沛的外向者均衡組成。

words.definition: 雙向性格者；中向性格的

examples.en: Many professionals are ambiverts who balance social networking with solitude.
examples.zh: 許多職場人士皆屬於兼具內外向特質、能自如切換社交與獨處的雙向性格者。

examples.en: An ambivert can enjoy a lively dinner party tonight and a quiet weekend alone tomorrow.
examples.zh: 雙向性格者既能享受今晚熱鬧的聚餐，也能泰然度過明天安靜獨處的週末。

examples.en: Research indicates that ambiverts often make excellent salespeople because they listen as well as they talk.
examples.zh: 研究顯示，雙向性格者往往能成為優秀的業務，因為他們既善於傾聽也善於表達。

words.definition: 同理心；換位思考共感力

examples.en: Genuine empathy involves putting yourself in another person's shoes.
examples.zh: 真正的同理心在於懂得設身處地、站在對方的立場體會其真實感受。

examples.en: Nurses must demonstrate both clinical competence and deep emotional empathy.
examples.zh: 護理人員必須同時具備臨床專業技能與深厚的情感同理心。

examples.en: Reading literary fiction has been shown to increase interpersonal empathy in readers.
examples.zh: 閱讀文學小說已被證實能增強讀者對他人的人際同理能力。

examples.en: We expressed our deepest sympathy to the family during their bereavement.
examples.zh: 我們在喪家痛失摯愛之際，向家屬致上了最深切誠摯的哀悼與慰問。

examples.en: I have a lot of sympathy for parents trying to work from home with young kids.
examples.zh: 我非常同情那些必須一邊居家工作一邊照顧年幼小孩的父母們。

examples.en: His radical proposal received very little sympathy from the conservative committee.
examples.zh: 他那激進的提案幾乎沒有獲得保守委員會的任何贊同或支持。

examples.en: Volunteers treat shelter animals with boundless warmth and tender compassion.
examples.zh: 志工們以無比溫暖的愛心與溫柔的慈悲心細心照護動物收容所裡的毛孩。

examples.en: Mother Teresa was globally renowned for her selfless compassion toward the destitute.
examples.zh: 德蕾莎修女以其對赤貧貧民無私奉獻的慈悲關懷而享譽全球。

examples.en: A truly humane society treats its most vulnerable members with dignity and compassion.
examples.zh: 一個真正仁慈的社會會以尊嚴與關懷來對待其最弱勢的成員。

examples.en: Cultivating psychological resilience helps youth bounce back from failures.
examples.zh: 培養強大的心理韌性能幫助青年學子在遭遇挫折跌倒後迅速重新站起。

examples.en: The coastal community showed incredible resilience following the destructive typhoon.
examples.zh: 沿海社區在經歷了破壞性強烈的颱風襲擊後展現了驚人的復原韌性。

examples.en: Physical fitness and adequate sleep are key pillars of mental resilience.
examples.zh: 良好的身體素質與充足的睡眠是構築心理韌性的重要支柱。

examples.en: Unwavering optimism enabled the founder to overcome early startup hurdles.
examples.zh: 堅定不移的樂觀信念支撐著創辦人成功克服創業初期的重重艱難險阻。

examples.en: Despite economic downturns, she approached new ventures with cautious optimism.
examples.zh: 儘管經濟面臨景氣衰退，她仍以審慎樂觀的態度開展新的商業投資。

examples.en: A healthy dose of optimism encourages people to pursue ambitious dreams.
examples.zh: 適度的樂觀心態能激勵人們勇敢追求遠大的夢想。

examples.en: Chronic pessimism often blinds people to promising real-world opportunities.
examples.zh: 長期習慣性的悲觀心態往往會讓人對真實世界中大有可為的良機視而不見。

examples.en: The analyst warned that pervasive market pessimism could trigger a self-fulfilling drop.
examples.zh: 分析師警告，市場上普遍存在的悲觀情緒可能會引發自我實現的下跌。

examples.en: It requires conscious effort to overcome pessimism and recognize positive outcomes.
examples.zh: 克服悲觀思維並學會看見正面的成果需要刻意的心理調整。

examples.en: Encouraging teacher praise boosts children's confidence and self-esteem.
examples.zh: 師長充滿溫度的正面鼓勵與肯定能顯著提升孩子的自信心與自尊感。

examples.en: Individuals with healthy self-esteem are less susceptible to peer pressure.
examples.zh: 擁有健全自尊心的人較不容易隨波逐流受到同儕壓力的不良影響。

examples.en: Therapy helped her rebuild her self-esteem after a painful personal divorce.
examples.zh: 心理諮商幫助她在經歷痛苦的個人離婚後重新建立了自我價值感。

examples.en: Mindfulness meditation deepens self-awareness regarding emotional triggers.
examples.zh: 練習正念冥想能深化對自我情緒引爆點與思維模式的敏銳自我覺察。

examples.en: Leaders with sharp self-awareness understand their weaknesses and hire accordingly.
examples.zh: 具備高度自我覺察的領導者深知自己的短處，並能據此聘用互補的人才。

examples.en: Journaling every evening is a simple yet powerful habit to cultivate self-awareness.
examples.zh: 每晚寫日記是培養敏銳自我覺察的一種簡單而強大的好習慣。

examples.en: Daily English study requires consistent self-discipline rather than luck.
examples.zh: 每天堅持學習英文需要持之以恆的嚴謹自律，而非單憑一時的三分鐘熱度。

examples.en: Elite Olympic athletes adhere to grueling training schedules through strict self-discipline.
examples.zh: 奧運頂尖運動員憑藉著嚴格的自律精神恪守極其艱苦的訓練課表。

examples.en: When motivation fades, self-discipline is what keeps you moving toward your goal.
examples.zh: 當一時的熱情褪去時，正是強大的自律精神支撐著你持續朝目標邁進。

examples.en: Intrinsic motivation driven by genuine curiosity produces lifelong learning.
examples.zh: 由內心純粹好奇心所驅動的內在動機，能孕育出一生受用無窮的終身學習。

examples.en: Freedom of speech is considered an intrinsic human right in democratic societies.
examples.zh: 言論自由在民主社會中被視為不可剝奪的固有內在人權。

examples.en: The vintage gold coin has significant intrinsic value due to its precious metal content.
examples.zh: 這枚古董金幣因其貴金屬含量而具有很高的內在實質價值。

examples.en: People with a growth mindset view mistakes as valuable learning lessons.
examples.zh: 具備成長型思維的人會將每一次的錯誤與挫折視為寶貴無比的學習契機。

examples.en: Adopting a growth mindset encourages employees to embrace challenging new projects.
examples.zh: 建立成長型思維能激勵員工欣然接受充滿挑戰性的全新專案任務。

examples.en: Teachers nurture a growth mindset by praising effort and perseverance rather than innate talent.
examples.zh: 老師透過讚賞努力與毅力而非天賦資質，來用心培養學生的成長型思維。

examples.en: High emotional intelligence (EQ) is essential for effective leadership.
examples.zh: 優異出眾的情緒智商（EQ）是成為卓越領導者不可或缺的核心領導素養。

examples.en: Emotional intelligence enables managers to handle tense negotiations smoothly.
examples.zh: 高情商讓主管在面對緊繃激烈的談判場合時能游刃有餘地圓融處置。

examples.en: Developing emotional intelligence helps people build stronger personal and professional bonds.
examples.zh: 培養情緒智商能幫助人們在日常生活與職場中建立更穩固的信任連結。

words.definition: 情緒調節；調控；規則規章

examples.en: Deep diaphragmatic breathing aids in rapid emotional regulation during stress.
examples.zh: 腹式深呼吸放鬆法有助於在面臨龐大高壓時迅速達成自主情緒調節穩定。

examples.en: Good sleep hygiene plays a crucial role in the brain's hormonal regulation.
examples.zh: 良好的睡眠衛生習慣在人體大腦荷爾蒙調控中扮演著至關重要的角色。

examples.en: Strict safety regulations protect factory workers from hazardous machinery.
examples.zh: 嚴格的安全規章守則能保護工廠作業人員免於危險機具的傷害。

words.definition: 留心的；正念專注的；留意的

examples.en: Be mindful of the present moment rather than worrying about the future.
examples.zh: 專注活在當下每一個美好的瞬間，而非徒勞為尚未發生的未來過度焦慮。

examples.en: Drivers should remain mindful of pedestrians when turning at busy crosswalks.
examples.zh: 駕駛人在行經繁忙斑馬線轉彎時應隨時留心留意過路行人。

examples.en: Practicing mindful eating encourages chewing slowly and savoring every flavor.
examples.zh: 練習正念飲食倡導細嚼慢嚥，並用心品嚐每一口食材的真實風味。

examples.en: Keeping a daily gratitude journal enhances happiness and life satisfaction.
examples.zh: 每天親筆寫下三件值得感恩的感恩日記能顯著提升幸福感與生活滿意度。

examples.en: The scholarship recipient expressed deep gratitude to all the generous benefactors.
examples.zh: 獎學金獲獎學子向所有慷慨解囊的善心資助者表達了由衷的感激之情。

examples.en: Fostering an atmosphere of gratitude within a company improves employee morale.
examples.zh: 在企業內部營造互相感謝感恩的工作氛圍能有效提振全體團隊士氣。

examples.en: Finding contentment in simple pleasures brings enduring inner tranquility.
examples.zh: 在生活微小的單純美好中尋得由衷的知足，能帶來恆久安詳的內心寧靜。

examples.en: A life of genuine contentment is rarely achieved through material wealth alone.
examples.zh: 真正知足常樂的人生心境，絕非單純依靠累積物質財富便能輕易獲得。

examples.en: The retired artisan sat in his garden, a look of profound contentment on his face.
examples.zh: 退休的老工匠悠然坐在花園裡，臉上洋溢著無比知足平靜的神采。

examples.en: Taking scheduled vacations prevents severe workplace mental burnout.
examples.zh: 給自己安排定期的放鬆休假能有效防範長年累積引發的嚴重職場心理倦怠。

examples.en: Working 80 hours a week without rest inevitably leads to physical and emotional burnout.
examples.zh: 每週連續高壓工時長達八十小時且得不到休整，必然會導致身心耗竭。

examples.en: HR introduced mental health days to help employees recover from chronic burnout.
examples.zh: 人資部設立了心理健康充電假，以協助員工從長期的職業倦怠中復原。

words.definition: 不知所措的；壓力不堪負荷的

examples.en: Take a short break when feeling overwhelmed by tight project deadlines.
examples.zh: 當面臨緊迫專案截止期限感到壓力爆棚、不知所措時，請先稍作停頓深呼吸。

examples.en: New parents often feel overwhelmed by the non-stop demands of caring for an infant.
examples.zh: 初為人父母的年輕爸媽常因照護新生兒無休無止的操勞而感到不堪負荷。

examples.en: Breaking large tasks into smaller steps prevents developers from feeling overwhelmed.
examples.zh: 將龐大繁複的任務拆解成細小步驟，能有效防止軟體工程師感到不知所措。

words.definition: 不安全感；缺乏自信；不安定

examples.en: Social media comparisons often fuel unnecessary personal insecurity.
examples.zh: 在社群網路上無休止的相互比較往往會加深內心不必要的不安全感。

examples.en: Warm parental encouragement helps teenagers overcome deep emotional insecurity.
examples.zh: 父母溫暖適時的鼓勵能陪伴青少年克服內心深層的缺乏自信與不安感。

examples.en: Job insecurity due to automation was a primary theme during the union debate.
examples.zh: 自動化可能帶來的失業不安定感是工會辯論會上討論的核心焦點。

words.definition: 冒牌者症候群（自我懷疑）

examples.en: High achievers often secretly battle imposter syndrome despite great success.
examples.zh: 許多卓越優秀的高成就者儘管戰績斐然，內心深處卻常飽受冒牌者症候群所苦。

examples.en: She worried colleagues would discover she wasn't qualified, typical of imposter syndrome.
examples.zh: 她總擔心同儕會發現自己其實不夠資格，這是冒牌者症候群的典型心態。

examples.en: Talking openly with supportive mentors helps individuals navigate imposter syndrome.
examples.zh: 與包容開放的導師敞開心扉對談，能有效幫助個人走出冒牌者症候群的陰霾。

examples.en: Unrealistic perfectionism can lead to analysis paralysis and hesitation.
examples.zh: 不切實際、過度苛求的完美主義往往會讓人陷入過度分析而遲疑不前。

examples.en: Healthy striving focuses on growth, whereas neurotic perfectionism fears any flaw.
examples.zh: 健康的正向追求著眼於自我成長，而病態的完美主義則恐懼出現任何瑕疵。

examples.en: His extreme perfectionism caused him to miss several critical publishing deadlines.
examples.zh: 他那極端的完美主義性格導致他錯過了數個關鍵的稿件出版截稿日。

examples.en: The Pomodoro Technique is an effective tool to beat task procrastination.
examples.zh: 番茄鐘工作法是一套能高效打破拖延症、找回專注生產力的實用工具。

examples.en: Fear of failure is often the root psychological cause behind chronic procrastination.
examples.zh: 對失敗的深層恐懼往往是釀成長期習慣性拖延背後的根本心理病因。

examples.en: Putting away smartphones helps eliminate digital distractions that fuel procrastination.
examples.zh: 將智慧型手機收置一旁有助於隔絕數位誘惑，避免助長拖延症惡性循環。

words.definition: 壓力因應機制；因應策略

examples.en: Listening to acoustic music serves as a healthy stress coping mechanism.
examples.zh: 聆聽純木吉他輕音樂是他日常排解繁雜壓力的健康正向因應策略。

examples.en: Binge eating or excessive shopping can become harmful coping mechanisms for anxiety.
examples.zh: 暴飲暴食或過度購物可能會演變成應對內心焦慮的不良因應機制。

examples.en: Developing diverse coping mechanisms allows people to navigate crises resiliently.
examples.zh: 發展多元健全的壓力因應機制能讓人們在面對人生危機時更具韌性。

examples.en: Psychological safety allows team members to voice ideas without fear of ridicule.
examples.zh: 具備高度心理安全感的團隊文化能讓成員暢所欲言，無懼遭受嘲諷或指責。

examples.en: Google found that psychological safety was the single most important factor for high-performing teams.
examples.zh: Google 研調發現，團隊成員之間的心理安全感是驅動頂尖高績效團隊最重要的關鍵。

examples.en: When managers admit their own mistakes, it reinforces psychological safety across the office.
examples.zh: 當主管主動承認自身疏失時，能實質鞏固並深化整個辦公室的心理安全感。

examples.en: Setting clear personal boundaries prevents burnout from excessive commitments.
examples.zh: 學會劃定清晰堅定的人際心理界線，能防止因過度承攬過多請求而心力交瘁。

examples.en: Rivers often serve as the natural geographic boundary between neighboring countries.
examples.zh: 奔流的江河常常成為相鄰國境之間天然的地理界線。

examples.en: Healthy professional boundaries mean not answering non-urgent work emails past midnight.
examples.zh: 健全的職場邊界感意味著在午夜過後不再回覆非緊急的工作電子郵件。

examples.en: Teenagers learn to say no firmly when facing negative peer pressure.
examples.zh: 青少年學子應學會鼓起勇氣，在面對同儕盲從的不良誘惑壓力時堅定說不。

examples.en: Positive peer pressure can motivate students to form productive study groups.
examples.zh: 良性的同儕壓力能激勵學生自發組織互助共好的高效率讀書小組。

examples.en: Resisting peer pressure requires strong self-confidence and clear moral convictions.
examples.zh: 抗拒隨波逐流的同儕壓力需要堅定的自信心與清晰分明的道德底線。

words.definition: 享受獨處；平靜獨處時光

examples.en: Solitude is not loneliness; it is the refreshing joy of being with oneself.
examples.zh: 獨處並非孤獨寂寞；它是沉浸於自我對話、為靈魂充電的一種自在喜悅。

examples.en: The poet retreated to an isolated mountain cabin to write poetry in complete solitude.
examples.zh: 這位詩人隱居到一座幽僻深山木屋中，在全然寧靜的獨處中專心創作詩篇。

examples.en: Spending moments of quiet solitude each weekend helps restore mental clarity.
examples.zh: 每個週末給自己留有一段安詳沉靜的獨處時光，有助於重新找回思維清晰度。

examples.en: Community volunteer programs help elderly citizens overcome chronic loneliness.
examples.zh: 社區關懷志工訪視計畫能陪伴並幫助獨居長者走出長年內心的孤單與寂寞。

examples.en: Moving to a foreign country where you don't speak the language can induce sharp loneliness.
examples.zh: 隻身搬遷到一個語言不通的異國他鄉，往往會引發強烈的孤寂感。

examples.en: Having a loyal pet dog can provide companionship and effectively combat loneliness.
examples.zh: 飼養一隻忠心耿耿的毛孩寵物犬能提供溫暖陪伴，有效排解孤獨寂寞。

examples.en: Healthcare workers and social workers are vulnerable to compassion fatigue.
examples.zh: 第一線辛勞的醫護人員與社工師在長期高壓助人環境下容易產生同理心疲乏。

examples.en: Regular mental debriefing sessions protect emergency medical responders from compassion fatigue.
examples.zh: 定期進行心理輔導與壓力疏導，能保護急診第一線急救人員免受同理耗竭之苦。

examples.en: Compassion fatigue manifests as emotional numbness and decreased capacity for empathy.
examples.zh: 同理心疲乏通常表現為情感麻木鈍化以及換位共情能力的顯著衰退。

words.definition: 不予批判的；客觀包容的

examples.en: Counselors provide a safe, non-judgmental listening ear for troubled youth.
examples.zh: 心理諮商師為迷惘受挫的青少年提供了一個全然包容、不帶批判的傾聽環境。

examples.en: Being a supportive friend means offering a non-judgmental space to vent frustrations.
examples.zh: 作為一個真心支持的好朋友，意味著提供一個毫無評判成見的抒發宣洩空間。

examples.en: The support group welcomes all attendees with a completely non-judgmental attitude.
examples.zh: 該心理互助成長團體以全然客觀包容、不予評斷的溫暖態度歡迎所有成員。

examples.en: Validating a friend's painful feelings helps them feel truly heard and loved.
examples.zh: 溫柔同理並肯定接納好友當下的痛苦情緒，能讓對方深感被全然理解與被愛。

examples.en: Experiments were conducted in multiple laboratories to validate the scientific hypothesis.
examples.zh: 各國多所實驗室紛紛進行了平行實驗，以驗證並證實這項科學假設。

examples.en: Don't forget to validate your parking ticket at the mall information desk before leaving.
examples.zh: 離開購物商場之前，別忘了先到商場服務台為您的停車票卡進行折抵認證。

words.definition: 情感認同接納；驗證確認

examples.en: Genuine emotional validation builds unshakeable intimacy between partners.
examples.zh: 伴侶之間發自內心的情緒接納與肯定，能築起堅不可摧的親密依附關係。

examples.en: Seeking constant external validation on social media can erode personal peace of mind.
examples.zh: 在社群媒體上無休止地尋求外界按讚認可，可能會逐步侵蝕內心的寧靜。

examples.en: Data validation checks ensure that only properly formatted email addresses are accepted.
examples.zh: 資料欄位驗證檢查機制能確保系統只接收格式正確合規的電子信箱地址。

examples.en: Starting your morning with positive affirmations boosts daily self-belief.
examples.zh: 早晨醒來給自己一段充滿力量的正向自我肯定語，能點亮一整天的自信風采。

examples.en: She nodded in silent affirmation when asked if she accepted the new promotion.
examples.zh: 當被問及是否願意接受這項新的升遷任命時，她默默點頭給予了肯定答覆。

examples.en: Writing affirmations on sticky notes reminds him of his inner strength during exams.
examples.zh: 將自我肯定語句寫在便利貼上，能在面對大考時隨時提醒自己具備內在實力。

examples.en: Practice self-compassion by speaking gently to yourself when you stumble.
examples.zh: 當自己不慎犯錯跌跤時，請練習以自我關懷的溫柔口吻安慰自己無須苛責。

examples.en: Self-compassion protects individuals from falling into toxic cycles of self-criticism.
examples.zh: 懂得自我關懷能保護個人免於深陷嚴苛自我批判與自責的惡性循環之中。

examples.en: Treating yourself with the same kindness you would show a good friend is the core of self-compassion.
examples.zh: 用對待摯友般的溫柔善意來寬待自己，正是自我關懷的最深層核心。

words.definition: 心流狀態；全神貫注體驗

examples.en: Coding complex software often brings programmers into a deeply focused flow state.
examples.zh: 專注編寫高難度軟體系統架構常讓程式設計師沉浸於物我兩忘的極致心流狀態。

examples.en: Musicians frequently enter a flow state during creative jam sessions where time seems to vanish.
examples.zh: 音樂家在即興合奏創作中經常進入渾然忘我的心流狀態，時間彷彿完全凝結。

examples.en: Minimizing phone notifications is crucial if you want to reach and sustain a productive flow state.
examples.zh: 若想要進入並維持高效率的心流狀態，關閉手機即時通知是至關重要的關鍵。

examples.en: Reaching Yushan's peak at dawn was a transcendent peak experience of my life.
examples.zh: 破曉時分登頂玉山主峰遠眺雲海日出，是我此生最震撼昇華的高峰體驗。

examples.en: Maslow described a peak experience as a profound moment of euphoria, oneness, and wonder.
examples.zh: 馬斯洛將高峰體驗定義為充滿極度愉悅、天人合一與敬畏驚奇的崇高瞬間。

examples.en: Performing in front of thousands of cheering fans gave the singer an unforgettable peak experience.
examples.zh: 在數萬名熱情歡呼的歌迷面前登台演出，為該歌手帶來了一生難忘的高峰體驗。

examples.en: Strong social bonds contribute far more to subjective well-being than wealth.
examples.zh: 溫暖深厚的人際情感連結對主觀幸福感的貢獻，遠遠凌駕於物質金錢之上。

examples.en: Sociologists assess subjective well-being using surveys covering life satisfaction and daily mood.
examples.zh: 社會學家透過涵蓋生活滿意度與日常情緒狀態的問卷調查來評估主觀幸福感。

examples.en: Engaging in meaningful volunteer service significantly elevates individuals' subjective well-being.
examples.zh: 積極投入具深層社會意義的志工服務，能顯著提升個人的主觀幸福感受。

examples.en: Donating blood regularly is a noble act of pure community altruism.
examples.zh: 養成定期挽袖捐血救人的好習慣，是體現社區無私利他精神的崇高善舉。

examples.en: Philosophers debate whether pure altruism truly exists without subconscious self-benefit.
examples.zh: 哲學家們長年辯論純粹的利他主義是否能在不帶任何潛意識自我回報下獨立存在。

examples.en: Firefighters exhibit extraordinary altruism every time they enter burning buildings.
examples.zh: 消防弟兄每次冒險衝入烈焰熊熊的火場，都展現了捨己為人的崇高利他精神。

examples.en: Altruistic volunteers dedicated their weekends to rebuilding disaster homes.
examples.zh: 充滿無私大愛精神的志工同仁奉獻出自己的休假週末，全力投入災後家園重建。

examples.en: He donated an anonymous million-dollar sum out of purely altruistic motives.
examples.zh: 他出於純粹無私利他的良善動機，匿名慷慨捐贈了高達百萬美元的善款。

examples.en: Evolutionary biologists examine altruistic behaviors observed across animal species.
examples.zh: 演化生物學家深入探究在多種動物群體中所觀察到的各類利他合作行為。

examples.en: Teaching children prosocial behaviors like sharing creates harmonious classrooms.
examples.zh: 自幼教導孩子學會分享與互助等親社會行為，能營造出充滿友愛溫馨的班級。

examples.en: Empathy is widely recognized as the primary emotional driver of prosocial action.
examples.zh: 同理心被公認為驅動個人採取積極親社會與助人行動的最主要情緒引擎。

examples.en: Video games that encourage teamwork can promote prosocial cooperation among young players.
examples.zh: 強調團隊協作通關的電子遊戲能有助於促進青少年玩家之間的親社會合作意識。

words.definition: 療癒；心靈癒合；具療癒力的

examples.en: Forest bathing (Shinrin-yoku) in Xitou provides profound emotional healing.
examples.zh: 在溪頭廣袤的柳杉森林中進行森林浴漫步，能帶來深層極致的身心靈療癒。

examples.en: Proper nutrition and rest accelerate the physical healing of surgical incisions.
examples.zh: 均衡的營養補充與充分休養能加速手術傷口在生理層面上的癒合復原。

examples.en: The gentle sound of ocean waves possesses remarkable emotional healing power.
examples.zh: 大海潮起潮落的溫柔浪濤聲具有撫慰焦躁、帶來心靈平靜的顯著療癒力量。

words.definition: 情感宣洩；情緒淨化釋放

examples.en: Crying openly while watching the heartwarming drama provided needed catharsis.
examples.zh: 觀看感人肺腑的溫馨催淚大戲痛快大哭一場，給緊繃心靈帶來了舒暢的宣洩。

examples.en: Ancient Greek tragedies were crafted specifically to evoke emotional catharsis in audiences.
examples.zh: 古希臘悲劇的精心編排旨在引導台下觀眾達成深層的情感共鳴與情緒淨化宣洩。

examples.en: Writing honest poetry allowed the wounded veteran to experience profound mental catharsis.
examples.zh: 揮毫寫下真情流露的詩作讓歷經滄桑的退役老兵體驗到了深層的心靈釋放。

examples.en: Living simply and letting go of grudges brings profound inner peace.
examples.zh: 簡約質樸地過生活並懂得放下心中的執念怨尤，能迎來深沉自在的內心平靜。

examples.en: She practices morning meditation every day to cultivate unwavering inner peace.
examples.zh: 她每天堅持晨間靜坐冥想，以涵養臨危不亂、泰然自若的內心平靜。

examples.en: External chaos cannot disturb those who have anchored their hearts in deep inner peace.
examples.zh: 外界環境的喧囂紛擾動搖不了那些內心早已扎根於深層平靜寧謐境界的人。

examples.en: Sun Moon Lake at dawn exudes breathtaking serenity and pure tranquility.
examples.zh: 晨曦破曉時分的日月潭水面波瀾不驚，散發著令人屏息的安詳幽靜之美。

examples.en: The remote mountain temple offered visitors a sanctuary of undisturbed tranquility.
examples.zh: 這座座落於崇山峻嶺間的偏僻寺院，為遠道而來的訪客提供了一處遠離塵囂的幽靜避風港。

examples.en: Soft candlelight and soothing background melodies created an aura of absolute tranquility.
examples.zh: 搖曳的溫暖燭光與舒緩柔和的背景旋律，營造出一種極致平靜安詳的舒心氛圍。

words.definition: 成就感；自我實現感；履行

examples.en: Mentoring underprivileged students gives retired educators deep personal fulfillment.
examples.zh: 悉心指導偏鄉弱勢學童課業讓退休教師收穫了難以言喻的深層自我實現感。

examples.en: True happiness comes from pursuing meaningful goals that offer lasting fulfillment.
examples.zh: 真正的幸福源自於追尋能為人生帶來深邃持久滿足感與成就感的崇高目標。

examples.en: The prompt fulfillment of overseas customer orders is the logistics center's top priority.
examples.zh: 迅速且準確地履行交付海外客戶訂單，是該物流配送中心運作的首要任務。

words.definition: 健康有益的；正派健全的

examples.en: Board game nights with good friends offer clean, wholesome entertainment.
examples.zh: 與三五好友相約在週末暢玩桌遊，是一種既溫馨健康又增進感情的正派娛樂。

examples.en: Eating wholesome home-cooked meals made with organic greens boosts overall immunity.
examples.zh: 經常品嚐使用有機時令蔬菜用心烹調的健康家常飯菜，能大幅提振整體免疫力。

examples.en: Animated family movies with positive uplifting values provide wholesome fun for all ages.
examples.zh: 傳遞正向積極溫暖價值觀的閤家歡動畫長片，能為男女老幼帶來老少咸宜的正派歡樂。
